tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Refresh the household profile using Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss updates and recent planning notes. Confirm household members, contact preferences, employment status, dependents, trusted contacts, insurance context, estate document status, and any major life changes that may affect planning recommendations. Update the profile to add Elia Lanternmoss as a dependent, include Jules’s updated employer benefits, and adjust the monthly spending to reflect infant care costs.

subTasks.title: Collect profile change information
subTasks.text: Request or compile updates for household members, addresses, contact preferences, employment, dependents, and major recent or expected life events.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Revise income, savings, spending, retirement timing, education funding, and family support assumptions in the planning record as applicable.

subTasks.title: Identify advice impacts
subTasks.text: Flag changes that may affect tax planning, risk management, estate coordination, cash flow, or investment allocation recommendations.

subTasks.title: Confirm profile completion
subTasks.text: Review the updated profile for consistency and note any remaining open questions for the next client conversation.

tickets.title: Prepare guardianship and estate coordination note
tickets.text: Prepare a planning note for the estate attorney covering the adoption, preferred guardian discussion, successor trustee considerations, and account ownership information needed before revising the will and trust for Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss.

tickets.title: Model insurance coverage assumptions after adoption
tickets.text: Model survivor income, mortgage payoff, childcare, and education cost assumptions for Rowan and Jules Lanternmoss to update the insurance coverage analysis after the adoption of Elia Lanternmoss.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to model survivor income, mortgage payoff, childcare, and education assumptions for both Rowan and Jules, due 2026-02-12.

tickets.title: Follow up on policy renewal details
tickets.text: Contact Rowan Lanternmoss or the insurance professional to confirm renewal status, premium change, coverage changes, beneficiary updates needed, and any action required before the renewal window closes. Obtain the current premium, conversion language, beneficiary page, and any renewal action requirements for the Silver Marmot term policy.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current premium, conversion language, beneficiary page, and any renewal action requirements before Rowan responds, due 2026-02-06.

tickets.title: Collect missing adoption and identification documents
tickets.text: Obtain Elia Lanternmoss’s final adoption decree, birth certificate, and Social Security number confirmation to support beneficiary updates and education account paperwork.

tickets.title: Update beneficiary records for life policies
tickets.text: Correct the primary beneficiary on Rowan’s individual term life policy from Casey Lanternmoss to Jules Lanternmoss and add Elia Lanternmoss as a contingent beneficiary per the updated estate plan.

tickets.title: Compare education funding account options
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison of ownership, contribution, and investment options for opening an education funding account for Elia Lanternmoss, including analysis of whether grandparents can contribute directly without affecting the household cash reserve target.

tickets.title: Troubleshoot client portal document upload
tickets.text: Investigate the portal rejection of the adoption decree PDF and provide an alternate secure delivery method for Rowan Lanternmoss to submit the document.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to troubleshoot the upload issue or provide an alternate secure delivery method, due 2026-01-27.
